content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) emphasizes the importance of using continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) metrics to establish glycemic goals in children and adolescents with diabetes. Metrics such as time in range (70-180 mg/dL), time below range (<70 mg/dL), time above range (>180 mg/dL), and glucose variability provide valuable insights for setting individualized glycemic targets and managing fluctuations in blood glucose levels effectively. Frequent glucose monitoring is particularly critical during the honeymoon phase of diabetes, a period characterized by partial remission and residual insulin production, or for individuals utilizing advanced diabetes management devices. This approach ensures optimal glycemic control and minimizes the risk of both hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia.
